_help: Default links the Refresh button (and auto-refresh) loads, in order. The easy way to add links is the board's Sources panel; once you edit the list there, this file is no longer used (Reset to sources.json defaults brings it back). After editing this file, run `npm run build` and reload the extension.
Links must be on www.naukri.com, in.indeed.com, www.instahyre.com, wellfound.com, cutshort.io, www.foundit.in or www.iimjobs.com. LinkedIn links are refused: the app never opens LinkedIn.

Instahyre ignores the filters in a search link and shows recommended jobs, so an Instahyre entry opens the opportunities page and clicks the saved search named in "savedSearch" (as listed under Saved Searches on Instahyre; case does not matter). Only the first page of results is read.
Wellfound's https://wellfound.com/jobs opens with the filters you last set there (role, location, job type), so set them on Wellfound. Only the first page of results is read.
maxPages: how many result pages of a search to load (default 1). Later pages load only while the previous page found new jobs.
Search links are sorted newest first automatically (Naukri sort=f, Indeed sort=date) unless the link already sets a sort.
Set "enabled": false to skip a link without deleting it.
